title: The grid settings open on a narrow window too
goal: On a narrow window the grid has no controls in the floating tool bar at all, and choosing Grid Settings on the View menu then does nothing: the settings have nothing to open on. Anyone working in a small window has no way to reach the grid at all beyond switching it on and off.
notes: EditorState.isGridSettingsPresented is a flag read by a .popover attached to EditorView.gridChip. Below EditorChromeLayout.gridChipMinCanvasWidth (620pt canvas) that chip is not built at all, so the flag goes true and nothing presents, and the flag stays true: widening past the threshold can then present it unbidden. Options: anchor the popover to the window (a sheet or a popover on the canvas), or open it as a small window. Found while doing with-the-grid-off-only-the-grid-switch-is-on-the on 2026-09-07.
acceptance: With a window narrow enough that the tool bar has no grid icon, View then Grid Settings opens the settings somewhere sensible
The settings show the same controls they show on a wide window
Widening the window afterwards does not make a popover appear by itself
